text: Karen was a high school student who was struggling academically. She was at risk of not graduating because she had neglected her coursework for months, spending her study hours daydreaming about traveling to Hawaii. A few weeks before final exams, her grades were far below the graduation requirement. To encourage her to pass, her father promised to pay for an all-expenses-paid trip to Hawaii if she studied diligently and passed all her remaining courses. Karen was thrilled by the offer. However, the cumulative academic deficit was already too severe and there was not enough time left in the semester to catch up on the coursework. Consequently, Karen failed her final exams, did not graduate with her class, and did not receive the trip to Hawaii. She spent the graduation evening crying in her bedroom, but her father did not purchase the plane tickets.
